column2: By-law on private wells in Kahawaththa Pradeshiya Sabha Authoritative Area
This by-law is enacted to regulate private wells, including the prescribing of standards for the maintenance of
the wells for regulatory purposes, to maintain the public health and safety of private wells maintained within the
area of authority of Kahawaththa Pradeshiya Sabha.
This by-law is known as the by-law of the private wells of Kahawaththa Pradeshiya Sabha.
No  individual  well  shall  be  constructed  in  the  authoritative  area  of  Kahawaththa  Pradeshiya  Sabha  (hearing
after refer to as the area) to get water for drinking or other purpose except as otherwise specified under a plan
approved by the Chairman for construction under the plan  for construction of all private wells.
